definitions.gloss: clear soup; clear broth; Japanese consommé
definitions.explanation: A light, clear Japanese soup made with dashi broth, seasoned with soy sauce and salt. Distinguished from miso soup by its transparency.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{汁物|しるもの}は{澄|す}まし{汁|じる}にした。
examples.english: I made clear soup for today's soup dish.

examples.japanese: お{正月|しょうがつ}には{澄|す}まし{汁|じる}の{雑煮|ぞうに}を{作|つく}る{地域|ちいき}がある。
examples.english: There are regions where ozoni (New Year soup) is made with clear broth.

examples.japanese: {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}に{豆腐|とうふ}と{三|み}つ{葉|ば}を{入|い}れて、さっぱりした{味|あじ}に{仕上|しあ}げた。
examples.english: I added tofu and mitsuba to the clear soup to give it a light, refreshing flavor.

notes:
Also called お{吸|す}い{物|もの}. Made from {出汁|だし} (dashi stock) seasoned with {醤油|しょうゆ} (soy sauce) and {塩|しお} (salt), with simple garnishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}を{作|つく}る: to make clear soup
- {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}の{雑煮|ぞうに}: New Year soup with clear broth
- {澄|す}まし{汁|じる}の{具|ぐ}: clear soup ingredients/garnishes

COMMON INGREDIENTS:
- {豆腐|とうふ}: tofu
- {三|み}つ{葉|ば}: mitsuba (Japanese parsley)
- {麩|ふ}: wheat gluten
- {柚子|ゆず}の{皮|かわ}: yuzu peel (as a garnish)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- お{吸|す}い{物|もの}: clear soup — essentially the same dish; this name is more common in everyday speech
- {味噌汁|みそしる}: miso soup — the other main type of Japanese soup; uses miso paste instead of clear seasoning
